name: CodeBlock
description: Multi-line source with an optional filename header, line numbers, highlighted, added and removed rows, copy and a caption.

keyboard: Tab reaches the copy button, then the code body when it scrolls; arrow keys scroll the focused body.
ariaRequirements: The body becomes a named, focusable region only when it overflows, so a short block adds no tab stop.
Added and removed rows carry a sign with translated alternative text (Added line, Removed line); state never rests on colour alone.
Line numbers are generated content with empty alternative text, so screen readers read the code only.
With a caption the block is a figure and the caption its figcaption.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-25: built from the Figma component (Astryx Code/CodeBlock and Geist code/code-block/snippet benchmarks) to replace CodeBlockWindow and CodeSnippet.

forbiddenUse: Use for a single command the reader pastes into a terminal; use Snippet.
Use for one identifier inside a sentence; use Code.
dense: flat code card: optional header (file icon, filename, language, copy) or floating copy; line numbers; highlighted/added/removed rows; caption; light or terminal theme; code string or Shiki tree

usage.description: CodeBlock shows source the reader will scan or paste. Pass code as a string (highlighted at runtime) or a Shiki tree from the MDX pipeline. Give a filename when the code has a paste destination, highlight only the lines under discussion and mark diffs as added and removed rows instead of comments, so copy-paste still yields working code.

bestPractices.description: Always set language; highlighting is the reason to choose CodeBlock over a plain pre.
Show a filename when the snippet belongs in a specific file; leave it out for throwaway examples.
Mark changes with addedLines and removedLines or language="diff"; copy leaves removed lines out.
Do not highlight most of the block; a block where every line is highlighted reads like no highlight.
Do not turn on line numbers for blocks under five lines.
Do not nest it in another scroll container; use maxHeight.

code.description:
Source to show. Highlighted at runtime for the common languages; with
`language="diff"` the leading +/- of each line become added and removed
rows. Pass either `code` or a pre-highlighted Shiki tree as `children`.

children.description:
A Shiki `<pre><code>` tree (rehype-pretty-code output). Callouts come
from the MDX meta string: a line range highlights, and a range with the
id "added" or "removed" marks a diff.

language.description: Language of the code; shown in the header and drives highlighting.

filename.description: File name shown in the header. Giving one turns the header on.

removedLines.description: Lines to mark as removed. Copy leaves them out.

theme.description:
`terminal` renders the block in the dark theme on any page. In the
high-contrast themes it follows the page so contrast stays at the
high-contrast level.

wrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

maxHeight.description: Cap the body height (any CSS length, or pixels) and scroll inside it.

copyLabel.description: Accessible name for the copy button.
